introHtml: Custom 23 oz bar wine glasses offer a generous capacity that stands out at corporate events, trade shows, and hospitality venues. This size accommodates a full pour with room for ice, making it ideal for wine tastings, cocktail receptions, or branded giveaways. Options like stemless tumblers and insulated designs keep beverages at the right temperature while providing ample space for your logo or message. Whether you are outfitting a hotel bar or planning a company celebration, 23 oz bar wine delivers both style and functionality.
